_comment:
'When Bingo hits a hero, they reveal a card from their hand. If an attack action card is revealed this way, Bingo gains go again. If a non-attack action card is revealed this way, draw a card.'

CONDITIONAL-KEYWORD SHAPE IS MANDATORY HERE: GoAgain appears in printed_keywords, and the engine applies every DB keyword unconditionally. loader.conditional_keywords() (loader.py:255-296) suppresses a printed keyword ONLY for an ability whose conditions include SOURCE_IS_ATTACK and whose DIRECT effects grant it via GAIN - the third ability satisfies both (go_again is in _GRANTABLE_KEYWORDS; the GAIN sits un-nested), and _recalculate_attack_power strips it at engine.py:1897-1900. Without that ability Bingo would have go again on every attack.

Behaviour lives on the ON_HIT trigger, gated by ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO (release notes scope everything to hitting A HERO; the condition is false when the attack was declared at a permanent/ally). Branch structure: 'attack action' is two claims because REF_IS_TYPE matches types UNION subtypes - Action AND Attack. 'Non-attack action' is Action AND NOT Attack (the NOT combinator reads the nested 'condition' key, condition_types.py:2147-2166). An Instant satisfies neither branch, so nothing happens - release note 1. DRAW defaults player SELF = Bingo's controller draws, not the revealer - release note 3. Empty hand: LOOK_AT amount 1 stores None (effect_types.py:3349), REF_IS_TYPE returns False on a None ref (condition_types.py:2006), so both branches fail and neither effect runs - release note 2 for free.

DEVIATION FROM TRIAGE (SELECT_FROM_REF): in paper the DEFENDER chooses which card to reveal. SELECT_FROM_REF prompts via _ask_player(state, cid, ...) with cid = the SOURCE card's controller (effect_types.py:3500) - Bingo's controller would make the choice, and its option list (card slugs) leaks the defender's entire hand to them. No DSL primitive asks the ZONE OWNER to choose a card to reveal (BANISH asks the owner but removes the card). LOOK_AT HAND amount 1 (top card of hand) is the non-leaky deterministic stand-in; the chooser gap is flagged, not silently guessed.

Flag lifecycle: ability 1 clears the flag at each ON_ATTACK, so a hit that reveals a non-attack action cannot inherit the flag from an earlier Bingo attack this turn (go again makes second Bingo attacks the common case). Ordering verified: ON_ATTACK is dispatched from the 'attacking' emit at engine.py:578, BEFORE the first power recalculation at engine.py:599, so no recalc ever evaluates a stale flag. FLAG_SET/SET_FLAG are the engine-implemented pair (condition_types.py:1004; effect_types.py:2023-2049 reads value:false as clear).

The third ability is strip-satisfier plus belt-and-braces; the trigger does the real work. GAIN keyword writes into combat.keyword_effects (state.py:1294-1296), which every recalculation unions back into combat.keywords (engine.py:1903) before chain-link resolution consults them - so the hit-time grant survives later recalcs, and the static's own re-grants are membership-checked and idempotent.
